newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post Business - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post Business - Oct 23.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Oct 23:
WASHINGTON - Frito-Lay Co., the giant snack food company owned by PepsiCo, has offered $1 million to support a popular children's program on the Public Broadcasting Service.
WASHINGTON - A federal court has put core provisions of the nation's new telecommunications law on hold.
WASHINGTON - Computer manufacturer Digital Equipment Corp. said it had a loss of $66 million in its third quarter.
WASHINGTON - MCI Communications Corp said its profit rose 10.5 percent in the third quarter and Lockheed Martin Corp. reported net income of $311 million in the quarter ended Sept. 30.
